notes.title: Update 1.0.11（April 5th, 2022）
notes.content:
1. Optimize the lawn color of NPC buildings so that they can be easily distinguished from player buildings. 
2. Add "Recruit" shortcut menu. 
3. The cool down time of "Quick Combat" is adjusted to 30 seconds.

tags.feature: 1. Optimize the lawn color of NPC buildings so that they can be easily distinguished from player buildings.

tags.balance_change: 3. The cool down time of "Quick Combat" is adjusted to 30 seconds.

notes.title: Update 1.0.10（January 14th, 2022）
notes.content: Improve the game experience: Add the "Asset Information" window. Now you can preview the player's current asset status and annual output at any time.

tags.feature: Improve the game experience: Add the "Asset Information" window. Now you can preview the player's current asset status and annual output at any time.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5（November 22nd, 2021）

1. Optimize game performance and improve game lag.
2. Fix the bug that view drifts appear while long pressing the mouse since loading into rooms.
3. Fix the bug that no income tip shows up while selling product amount is less than Customer Flow.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4（November 21st, 2021）
notes.content:
1. Optimize the indoor vision.
2. Add the Monthly Income data into the shop info window.
3. Add the "Increase Customer Flow" tip to the building panel of Apartment & Hotel.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3（November 17th, 2021）
notes.content:
1. Increase the display of dropped items and drop rate.
2. Increase the operation tips of the staff information panel.
3. Fix the bug that staffs and monsters cannot display attack power and attack speed values at 720p resolution.
4. Fix the bug that the combat result window does not pop up normally at the end of the first combat after entering the game.
5. Fix the bug that the staff idle in the dungeon page not running in the second loading.
6. Fix the bug that some windows did not close automatically.

5. Fix the bug that the staff idle in the dungeon page not running in the second loading.
6. Fix the bug that some windows did not close automatically.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2（November 16th, 2021）
notes.content:
1. Optimize the game performance and fix the screen stuck problem.
2. Optimize the game experience: The restriction that the mouse cursor is locked in the window in game has been lifted, and the function that MOVING THE MOUSE CURSOR TO THE EDGE OF THE SCREEN CAN HELP MOVING CAMERA has been deleted.
3. Fix the bug that "Game Over" did not end the combat in the combat scene.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1（November 14th, 2021）
notes.content:
1. Improve the operating experience: add the function of long-pressing the right mouse button to move the camera field of view.
2. Improve the game experience: add world time and coin display to the Explore Scene.
3. Fix the bug that some UI display is misplaced.
4. Fix spelling errors of some English words.
